spec.title: Letters from Lumen Bay
spec.description: A branching seaside story where every choice steers you toward a different ending.

scenes.speaker: Mira
scenes.text: The lighthouse went dark last night. Someone has to climb it before the fog rolls in. Will you come with me?

choices.label: It's too dangerous. Wait for morning.

scenes.speaker: Mira
scenes.text: At the top you find the keeper asleep beside a cold lamp. Mira laughs and lights it herself. The bay glows again.

scenes.speaker: Mira
scenes.text: By morning a fishing boat has run aground on the rocks. Everyone is safe, but Mira never quite looks at you the same way.

stages.title: Chapter 2 — The Message in the Tide

scenes.speaker: Old Bren
scenes.text: A bottle washed up with your name on the letter inside. Do you read it here on the pier, or take it home unopened?

scenes.speaker: Old Bren
scenes.text: It is from the keeper — an invitation to tend the light beside him. Bren claps your shoulder. The bay has chosen you.

scenes.speaker: Old Bren
scenes.text: At home the ink has faded to salt and silence. Some letters are only meant to be read by the sea.

meta.prompt: Cinematic video game cover art for "Letters from Lumen Bay", a Visual Novel game. Mood and style: A branching seaside story where every choice steers you toward a different ending. Perspective inspired by the game's portrait + text-box UI. Capture the core loop: read scene → choose → branch → reach an ending. Vertical portrait 4:5 composition, main subject framed in the upper two-thirds, bottom third kept simpler and darker for a title overlay, readable focal point at small mobile sizes. Dramatic lighting, rich color, highly detailed digital illustration. Original artwork only — no text, no words, no logos, no watermarks, no existing characters or brands.
